_comment: Pinned third-party C# libraries for the Tier A coverage study (#493).
Hermeticity here means SOURCE hermeticity — the harness only parses,
encodes and re-encodes these files with Roslyn, it never restores or
builds them — so the bar is: hand-written C#, no source generators or T4
templates in the studied subtree, no P/Invoke-heavy native interop,
permissively licensed, and small enough to shallow-clone. Humanizer's
repo root was NOT taken wholesale for that reason (it ships
hand-written src/Humanizer library is studied. Each `ref` is a commit SHA
resolved from the repo's default branch on 2026-09-03 via the GitHub API,
so a Tier A number is reproducible; bump it deliberately, never to chase a
number. `lib` is the subtree that is actually studied — note
Newtonsoft.Json's capital `Src`. An unreachable pin is reported separately
and is NOT scored as a failure.
